mapper.select: select * from iot_task_item where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'PENDING' order by row_no asc, id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into iot_task_item (id, task_id, tenant_id, item_no, item_key, item_name, row_no, status, message, raw_data, result_data, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time) values
(#{item.id}, #{item.taskId}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.itemNo}, #{item.itemKey}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.rowNo}, #{item.status}, #{item.message}, #{item.rawData}, #{item.resultData}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as runningCount from iot_task_item where task_id = #{taskId}
